definition_alignment.subtype_api: orthogonalProjectionOnto is the current API; orthogonalProjection is a deprecated definitionally equal alias.
definition_alignment.bridge: P_eq_subtype_projection proves P equals subtype inclusion composed with orthogonalProjectionOnto.

assumptions: V and E are real inner-product spaces with their associated normed additive groups
FiniteDimensional ℝ V and FiniteDimensional ℝ E
No injectivity, surjectivity, or nonzero-rank assumption on L
proved_scope: Actual orthogonal residual projector onto range(L)^orthogonal
Ambient endomorphism idempotence and composition idempotence
Annihilation of every L v and P composed with L equals zero
P x = x - orthogonal fitted-range projection of x
Exact Metric.infDist(x, range L) = norm(P x)
Existence of a coefficient attaining the exact residual and global minimum
Complementary projector rank equals finrank(E) minus finrank(range L)
Named covariance-projector idempotence and P composed with P.adjoint equals P
Explicit zero-range and full-range projector boundary lemmas
not_proved: Whitening construction W from an SPD covariance C
Equivalence to the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse formula I - (WF)(WF)^+
Matrix-level GLS mapping from a non-Euclidean quadratic form to the already-whitened L interface
Diagonalization into nu ones and zeros
Probabilistic covariance transformation or Gaussian/chi-square/coverage law
Full historical CAS08-C01/C02 contract admission or four-axis closure
theorem_types:
CAS08ProjectionBridge.P_eq_subtype_projection.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) :
  CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L =
    (CAS08ProjectionBridge.K L).subtypeL ∘SL (CAS08ProjectionBridge.K L).orthogonalProjectionOnto
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_idempotent.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
  (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) ((CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x) = (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_comp_self.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) :
  CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L ∘SL CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L = CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_symmetric.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x y : E) :
  inner ℝ ((CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x) y = inner ℝ x ((CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) y)
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_selfAdjoint.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) : IsSelfAdjoint (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L)
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_annihilates.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (v : V) : (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) (L v) = 0
CAS08ProjectionBridge.projector_comp_response.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) : CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L ∘SL L = 0
CAS08ProjectionBridge.residual_identity.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
  (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x = x - (CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L).starProjection x
CAS08ProjectionBridge.least_squares_distance.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
  Metric.infDist x ↑(CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L) = ‖(CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x‖
CAS08ProjectionBridge.least_squares_lower_bound.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) (v : V) : ‖(CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x‖ ≤ ‖x - L v‖
CAS08ProjectionBridge.least_squares_attained.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
  ∃ v, x - L v = (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x ∧ ∀ (w : V), ‖x - L v‖ ≤ ‖x - L w‖
CAS08ProjectionBridge.complementary_rank.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) :
  Module.finrank ℝ ↥(↑(CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L)).range + Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L) =
    Module.finrank ℝ E
CAS08ProjectionBridge.complementary_rank_sub.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) :
  Module.finrank ℝ ↥(↑(CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L)).range =
    Module.finrank ℝ E - Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L)
CAS08ProjectionBridge.covariance_projector_algebra.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
  (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) ((CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x) = (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) x
CAS08ProjectionBridge.covariance_adjoint_algebra.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) :
  CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L) = CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L
CAS08ProjectionBridge.zero_range_projector.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (h : CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L = ⊥) :
  CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E
CAS08ProjectionBridge.full_range_projector.{u_1, u_2} {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [finV : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (h : CAS08ProjectionBridge.responseRange L = ⊤) :
  CAS08ProjectionBridge.P L = 0
